queries.title: Company names
queries.description: Paste one company name or legal name (razón social) per line. No API keys needed — enrichment is included.
queries.prefill:
Albrok Mediacion S.A.
Willis Iberia Correduria De Seguros Y Reaseguros, S.A.
Telefonica S.A.

companies.title: Companies (structured)
companies.description: Optional structured list. When provided, takes priority over the textarea. Only company names are required.

source_id.title: Source ID
source_id.description: Your CRM / spreadsheet row id (returned unchanged).

legal_name.title: Company / legal name
legal_name.description: Brand name or legal name / razón social.

city.title: City
city.description: Optional city hint to improve matching.

country.title: Country
country.description: Optional country hint. Defaults to España.

tax_id.title: Tax ID
tax_id.description: Optional tax id (NIF/CIF). Stored on the output row; not required for resolution.

website.title: Known website (skip if already enriched)
website.description: If you already have a good website + confirmed match, the Actor can skip re-resolving this row.

match_status.title: Known match status
match_status.description: Prior status (confirmed / high_confidence). Used with known website to skip.

linkedin_url.title: Known LinkedIn URL
linkedin_url.description: Preserved when the row is skipped.

country_code.title: Search country
country_code.description: Google Search country (e.g. es, fr, us). Default es.

language_code.title: Search language
language_code.description: Google Search language (e.g. es, en). Default es.

debug.title: Include debug fields
debug.description: When true, also return candidate lists and scoring details (larger output).
